caribbean.headline: Caribbean Conditions: Antigua
caribbean.paragraph: Antigua in the Eastern Caribbean is the highest-impact location in the Caribbean this period, with winds peaking at 15 kt and seas building to 3.6 ft with ESE swell at 8s periods. 100% rain probability -- expect disrupted conditions for shore excursions and tender operations.

mediterranean.headline: Mediterranean Conditions: Mykonos
mediterranean.paragraph: Mykonos in the Eastern Mediterranean is the highest-impact location in the Mediterranean this period, with winds peaking at 21 kt and seas building to 5.1 ft with NNE swell at 6s periods. less than 10% rain probability -- overall conditions are favorable for cruise operations.
